answer.says: Ramesh, please bring the chai to the study. The light here is better for the pen, and I wish to finish this paragraph before the heat fully settles.
answer.thought: The dust in the study is indeed a suspension, a state of matter that refuses to resolve. I am trying to write to Lindner about the nature of the state, but the ink feels heavy. The hazy air outside suggests a city that is not yet fully awake to its own contradictions. I will finish this letter; it is a matter of discipline and correspondence.
